body:
Empty arrays are uniformly recorded as `[]`.

This will fix the linking issues without needing #72514.

```tscn
[gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://cmubfq7pnrbef"]

[ext_resource type="PackedScene" uid="uid://bulce0eugh1sb" path="res://scenes/Inherited.tscn" id="1_htqdq"]

[node name="Main" type="Node2D" unique_id=1139503000]

[node name="Inherited" parent="." unique_id=579562533 instance=ExtResource("1_htqdq")]
custom_resources = []
plain_resources = []
built_in_resources = []
```
Edit: 
Nested arrays are not supported.
